workload_hashes: SHA256 of contiguous CPU tensor bytes (int64 indices, float32 src), outside timing/profiling. Source hashes may differ across CUDA/PyTorch stacks despite equal seeds.
gpu_busy_proxy: (profile CUDA kernel milliseconds / profile_repeat) / unprofiled median_ms; below 0.6 flags possible host overhead. Not hardware utilization; can exceed 1 or be distorted by profiler timing.

timing_scopes.index_add: fresh dense output allocation, zeroing, and indexed accumulation
timing_scopes.scatter_add: fresh dense output allocation, zeroing, and scatter accumulation; index view setup excluded
timing_scopes.embedding: retained forward graph; backward including dense gradient allocation; grad clearing excluded

timing: Unprofiled CUDA events, inner=1; setup, forward and prepare outside events. Profiler overhead is not primary timing.

profiler_total_definitions.total_profile_cpu_time_ms: Sum of CPU self times; avoids adding inclusive parent and child times.
profiler_total_definitions.total_profile_cuda_time_ms: Sum of CUDA kernel-event durations, or CPU operator self-device times in legacy fallback; not wall time.
profiler_total_definitions.number_cuda_ops: CUDA event call count; fallback counts CPU operators with attributed CUDA time, not kernels.
profiler_total_definitions.number_cpu_ops: CPU event call count, including runtime and profiling annotations.
profiler_total_definitions.top_cuda: Top 10 CUDA kernel keys when present; otherwise CUDA-attributed CPU keys, else CPU-time fallback explicitly marked.

correctness: CPU float64 reference cast to float32; abs_error <= 1e-5 + 1e-6 * row_count
limitations: Warm-cache subset only; CSV cache_mode=cold is rejected.
CUDA-event samples are unbatched and fixed op order, unlike randomized/batched Phase 2 confirmation.
Profiler totals span all profile_repeat invocations, not one invocation.
Key-average inclusive times can overlap; do not sum them as total runtime.
No profile attribution is claimed if CUDA time is unavailable.
